   [38;2;90;86;224mtab / shift+tab, 1–5  [m [38;2;108;108;108mswitch tab (the scan view)[m                                                
   [38;2;90;86;224m↑ ↓  j k  pgup pgdn   [m [38;2;108;108;108mmove or scroll[m                                                            
   [38;2;90;86;224menter                 [m [38;2;108;108;108mremove the selected suggestion (or the marked ones), after you confirm[m    
   [38;2;90;86;224mspace                 [m [38;2;108;108;108mmark several suggestions to remove together[m                               
   [38;2;90;86;224me                     [m [38;2;108;108;108mexplain the selected suggestion[m                                           
   [38;2;90;86;224mx                     [m [38;2;108;108;108mhide this kind of suggestion from now on[m                                  
   [38;2;90;86;224md  (after /reclaim)   [m [38;2;108;108;108mreview the RISKY items it left alone; each needs its ID typed[m             
   [38;2;90;86;224m/                     [m [38;2;108;108;108mcommand palette[m                                                           
   [38;2;90;86;224m?                     [m [38;2;108;108;108mthis help[m

 [1;38;2;28;28;28mCommands[m                                                                                           
   [38;2;90;86;224m/scan                 [m [38;2;108;108;108mscan the disk again, then show the full report (esc stops a scan)[m         
   [38;2;90;86;224m/reclaim              [m [38;2;108;108;108mscan, then clean every SAFE and CAUTION item at once (esc stops it)[m       
   [38;2;90;86;224m/retire               [m [38;2;108;108;108minstalled software and its data folders; delete what you don't need[m       
   [38;2;90;86;224m/explore              [m [38;2;108;108;108mwhere the space is, as a folder tree you can open[m                         
   [38;2;90;86;224m/vitals               [m [38;2;108;108;108mlive CPU, memory, disk, network and battery, with a health score[m          
                                                                                                    
 [1;38;2;28;28;28mSafety[m                                                                                             
[38;2;108;108;108m   /reclaim removes every SAFE and CAUTION item right after its scan, without[m                       
[38;2;108;108;108m   asking (esc stops it; nothing RISKY is ever included). Everything else asks:[m                     
[38;2;108;108;108m   Enter shows what will go and how[m                                                                 
[38;2;108;108;108m   much space comes back; Enter again removes it (SAFE and CAUTION items).[m                          
[38;2;108;108;108m   A RISKY item also needs its code typed. Each item is checked again just[m                          
[38;2;108;108;108m   before it's removed, and skipped if it changed. Removed items are deleted[m                        
[38;2;108;108;108m   for good, so the space is freed at once. Everything is in macdoc log.[m
